(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin Rotary & Mission Systems is hiring an early-career Software Engineer for Combat Systems DevSecOps. The role focuses on developing software using Java and/or C++ and leveraging related development tools and environments.
Early-Career Software Engineer developing Combat Systems DevSecOps software with Java, C++, and associated development tools

Responsibilities:
• In this role, you will be developing software using Java and/or C++ . Coding in/and leveraging related development tools and environments will be the major focus for this role

Requirements:
• BS Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or closely related technical field
• Knowledge and/or experience with tools like Jira, Git, BitBucket, Crucible and/or Confluence
• Knowledge and/or experience with design and development of software using JAVA or C++
• Must be a US Citizen
• This position will require a government security clearance
• This position is located at a facility that requires special access

Preferred:
• Knowledge and/or experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and/or DevSecOps environment
• Demonstrated interest and ability to learn new tools and technologies and successfully leverage those to successfully complete projects in a timely manner
• Ability to work well in a team environment and independently
• Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and effectively both verbally and in writing
